Name: Modular Tools
Author: jokthefoo
Description:
[b][size=4]Features:[/size][/b][list]
[*][b]Attachable Upgrades:[/b] Equip tools with upgrades that add special abilities or stats.
[*][b]Fully Customizable:[/b] Choose which upgrades fit your playstyle — speed, area of effect, power, and more.
[*][b]Progressive Unlocking:[/b] Discover new upgrades as you level up your skills.
[*][b]Easy Management:[/b] Swap, upgrade, or remove upgrades at any time.
[/list]
[b][size=4]﻿Install:[/size][/b][list]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Install the requirement. ([url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1348]SpaceCore[/url]﻿)
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into Stardew Valley/Mods.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list][u][u]
﻿[b][size=3]Upgrades are added/removed from your tools exactly like bait/tackles from the Fishing Rod.[/size][/b][/u][b][size=4]
[/size][/b][/u]
[b][size=4]How It Works:[/size]
﻿Basic tools work the same
﻿[/b]Now instead of your tools automatically improving after having Clint upgrade them, upgrading unlocks attachment slots (like the fishing rod).
﻿Each tool has a limited number of slots based on its base upgrade level Copper (1), Steel (2), Gold (3), Iridium (4).

﻿Upgrades are unlocked by leveling up your skills, the first few unlock at Farming level 2 and Mining level 2.

﻿This mod should work when added mid-play through (although you miss out on some of the fun!)
﻿Clint's tool costs are cheaper as the upgrades require resources as well. This can be toggled on/off in the config.

[size=4][b]Basic Upgrades:[/b][/size][b]
﻿[size=2]Length/Width:[/size][/b][size=2] Increase the area of effect of your Hoe/Watering Can[/size][b]
﻿Power:[/b][size=2] Increase the strength of your Pickaxe/Axe. (1 upgrade = copper strength, 2 = steel strength, 3 = gold strength, 4 = iridium strength)
[b] ﻿Capacity: [/b]Dramatically increase the water capacity of your Watering Can

Advanced Upgrades
[spoiler]
Fire Upgrade[spoiler] Axe: Makes trees drop coal instead of wood.
Pickaxe: Gives more coal when mining. [spoiler]1.2 extra coal per 10 rocks on average.[/spoiler][/spoiler]
Water Upgrade[spoiler] Hoe: Makes the hoe water after tilling.
Watering Can: Makes watered soil stay watered for an extra day.[spoiler]Also changes the area of effect to be blue.[/spoiler][/spoiler]
Lucky Upgrade[spoiler] Increases your luck when using the tool it is attached to.[spoiler]+1 luck[/spoiler] [/spoiler]
Speed Upgrade[spoiler] Increases the animation speed when using the tool.[spoiler]10% faster[/spoiler] [/spoiler][size=2]

Earth Upgrade[spoiler] Will place fertilizer when using hoe, or replant tree seeds if using axe.[/spoiler][/size]
[/spoiler]

Lucky Ducky Upgrade[spoiler] Increases your luck when using the tool it is attached to.[spoiler]+2 luck[/spoiler][/spoiler]

End-End Game[spoiler]Your tools can now be forged with a Galaxy Soul...[spoiler]Gives one extra attachment slot[/spoiler][/spoiler]
[/spoiler]

[/size][b][size=4]Support[/size][/b]
[size=2] If you encounter any bugs or have any ideas for new Upgrades, please let me know!
[/size] ﻿There is also a debug command "modulartools_attachment_slots_reset" to try to fix up any tools that are missing their attachment slots.

[size=4][b]BEFORE REMOVING MOD:[/b][/size]
If you want/need to remove the mod mid-play through before removing the mod run the debug command "modulartools_remove_all_attachments". This will clear all ﻿tools of attachment slots and their upgrades preventing crashes after this mod is removed.

Happy Upgrading!
